## Context
During the 2026-09-07 rotation (auspicial-wily-warbler), SSM was treated as the single point of rotation, but two GitHub Actions repo secrets mirroring SSM values went stale: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and JIRA_API_TOKEN kept their 2026-08-12 values until manually synced on 2026-09-08. Workflows reference: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GERRIT_SSH_PRIVKEY, JIRA_API_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY, REBAR_BOT_SIGNING_KEY (+ JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER non-secrets). Any secret that lives in BOTH SSM and GitHub Actions must be rotated in both, or CI fails with stale credentials after the old value is revoked.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A documented inventory maps each GitHub Actions secret to its SSM source (or marks it GitHub-only), in the ops runbook that owns rotation (infra/runbooks/).
- [x] The rotation runbook includes an explicit GitHub Actions sync step (gh secret set from SSM) with a copy-paste command per mapped secret.
- [x] Optional (evaluate): a drift check that compares gh secret updated_at against SSM parameter LastModifiedDate and flags mirrors older than their source, surfaced through an existing operational channel (no new CI-provider-only mechanism; must have an operation-linked or in-process fallback per project.portability).

## Verification
- Runbook review: rotating any mapped secret following the runbook leaves no stale mirror.
